newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Mint tenders for 454,000 kg copper.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Mint tenders for 454,000 kg copper.

text.p: The U.S. Mint said on Wednesday it was seeking 454,000 kg of electrolytic copper cathodes in the weeks beginning June 30 and July 7.
Offers should be submitted by fax to the Mint before 10 a.m. EDT (1400 GMT) on June 2.

The Mint said it sought the copper in four lots. The first lot was for 203,000 kg of copper to be delivered by rail car to Olin Corp in East Alton, Ill. The second lot was for 203,000 kg to be delivered by rail car to PMX Industries in Cedar Rapids, Ia.
A third lot of 18,144 kg was to be delivered by truck to Altrista Corp in Detroit, and a fourth lot of 29,856 was to be delivered by truck to Altrista Corp in Shelby, N.C.
